name: The Ogres of Feralas
label: Quest
description: Rok Orhan at Camp Mojache, satisfied that you are a true fighter, sends you on to the High Wilderness, southwest of the camp. Among ruined structures…
intro: Rok Orhan at Camp Mojache, satisfied that you are a true fighter, sends you on to the High Wilderness, southwest of the camp. Among ruined structures once held by the night elves, Gordunni ogres far tougher than before are to be pushed back. This follows The Ogres of Feralas.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now that you have proven that you are a true fighter, I trust that you possess the courage to continue with the task at hand.

Travel to the High Wilderness, southwest of here. There lie some abandoned and destroyed structures, on land that once belonged to the night elves. Look for these ruins, and when you see the withered trees and desecrated terrain, you will find the Gordunni. Push them back.
These ogres are much stronger than the ones you faced previously, friend. Be aware.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you found the ruins, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: You have proven yourself to be a trustworthy and dependable ally, friend.
